counts.scope: All 36 controls separately reported, binary answer alphabet shared with neural arms. Fitting counts reset at episode boundaries; optional observed-prefix updates reset per development episode, no previous development labels. Integer lookups/copies are separate from neural FLOPs. Bound does not cover arbitrary reads at other count addresses.

protocol.objective: Query-only binary cross entropy for every arm; no bit/XOR feature supplied
protocol.state: New empty state per complete episode; full-episode credit
protocol.development: Held-out paired suffixes; min query loss over fixed passes; exploratory
protocol.race_noise: Coupled by group/pass, independent of target; evaluation cannot change fitting RNG
protocol.scope: Integrated controlled dependency diagnostic, not semantic language or general resource supremacy

work.scope: Whole-fit estimate extrapolates recorded complete first/last optimizer windows of pass1, not exhaustive routing-occupancy accounting. Prefix forward/loss/backward/normalization/clipping/Adam and losing proposals charged; 2 FLOPs/MAC plus unit specials. Development passes, RNG, integer lookups, checkpoint I/O, traffic and energy separate. Inference includes all episode inputs and query loss.
